$comment: Culture themes shown on a country page. Each theme belongs to one country and points at existing content by id: storyIds = CC.stories, sceneIds = CC.scenarios (optional practice), phraseIds = CC.phrases. icon = key in CC.icons (svgs.js). status: ready = has at least one story; planned = shown honestly as not written yet (no ids). question is the guiding question for the theme; blurb says what the theme covers here and is editorial, never a cultural claim. aliases = old topic ids from earlier versions, so old links like vietnam.html#topic-greetings still open the right theme. Themes can differ between countries; do not create empty themes just to match another country.

topics.label: People & everyday life
topics.question: How do people live, communicate and build relationships?
topics.blurb: Arriving at a home, crossing the street, asking before a photo and keeping calm in public, as covered by our Hà Nội sources.

topics.label: Food & dining
topics.question: What do food and the table say about this place?
topics.blurb: A family dinner: shared dishes, a host who serves you, saying you are full and joining a toast.

topics.vi: Lễ hội, tín ngưỡng & truyền thống

topics.blurb: Family words instead of “you”, and calling people with “ơi”. The phrasebook has every phrase.
